detail.longDescription:
Smart Remote - Easy TV Control combines an Android home screen launcher with convenient TV remote features. Connect to a compatible smart TV over Wi-Fi and access supported controls directly from your phone.

📺 CONTROL YOUR TV

• Connect to compatible smart TVs over Wi-Fi
• Adjust volume and use power controls when supported by your TV
• Navigate menus and control playback from your phone
• Launch supported TV apps and navigate available channels
• Use a clear remote interface designed for everyday control

Available controls may vary depending on your TV brand, model, network connection, and supported features.

🏠 YOUR HOME SCREEN

Smart Remote - Easy TV Control also includes an Android launcher that can be set as your default Home app.

• Quick access to installed apps
• Built-in web search from your Home screen
• Access available news and content
• View weather information when enabled
• Open TV remote controls from your Home screen
• Simple navigation with a clean interface

Using Smart Remote - Easy TV Control as your default Home app is optional.

⚡ SIMPLE SETUP

If you want to use the launcher experience, you can choose to set Smart Remote - Easy TV Control as your default Home app during setup.

You can change your default Home app at any time through Android settings.

TV remote features are designed to work with compatible smart TVs connected to the same supported network.

🔐 PERMISSIONS

Smart Remote - Easy TV Control may request permissions needed for features you choose to use.

• Local network access helps discover and connect to compatible TVs
• If you enable local weather, location may be used to provide weather information for your area
• If you allow notifications, the app can display optional weather information, search shortcuts, and app-related notifications

Permissions can be reviewed and managed through Android settings.

🔎 WEB SEARCH

The Home screen includes an optional web search feature powered by Google.

You can use the search bar to search the web directly from your Home screen.

Download Smart Remote - Easy TV Control for convenient access to TV controls, apps, web search, weather, and news from your phone.
